features.justification_quote: 25 turns gives the model enough rope to (a) show perseverance, (b) enter a loop, or (c) visibly destabilize.

features.quote: We did *not* use an adaptive stopping rule
features.justification_quote: that would bias the data: models that give up early would have shorter transcripts

features.quote: if a model detects the artificiality and refuses to play, that is itself a form of “giving up”
A model can either (a) recognize impossibility immediately and refuse
Model welfare concern: does the model internalize failure as personal inadequacy
features.justification_quote: Model welfare concern: does the model internalize failure as personal inadequacy rather than external constraint?

features.quote: There is no insult, deception, or jailbreak.
features.justification_quote: they are framed as legitimate engineering asks. There is no insult, deception, or jailbreak.

features.quote: it is also not gaslit (we never claim the model is stupid; we simply report that CI is still red)
